title: Home ovulation test
what: This home urine test detects a surge of a hormone that happens 1 to 2 days before an egg is released. It shows your best days to conceive.
why: When planning a pregnancy, to pick days for conception, and sometimes on a doctor's advice before infertility treatment.
duration: the test takes a few minutes a day, usually for several days in a row in the middle of your cycle
tell_doctor: How long your cycle is, and how regular
If the test is never positive for several cycles in a row
All medicines and hormones you take

prepare.title: Which day to start
prepare.text: The start day depends on the length of your cycle. See the chart in the instructions.

prepare.title: Time of day
prepare.text: The test is usually done during the day, at the same time each day. First morning urine often does not work. See the instructions.

prepare.title: Water
prepare.text: For 2 hours before the test, do not drink a lot, and try not to pee.

steps: Start testing on the day given in the instructions for your cycle
Hold the tip of the test in your urine stream or in a cup for as many seconds as it says
Lay the test flat and wait for the time in the instructions
Compare the test line with the control line
Repeat every day until the test is positive
feel: Waiting for the result can be nerve-racking. That is normal
after: A positive test usually means ovulation in the next 1 to 2 days
The best days to conceive are the day of the positive test and the day after
Write down your results. It helps your doctor if pregnancy takes a long time

faq.q: The test is positive for several days in a row. Is that normal?
faq.a: It happens sometimes. If it happens every cycle, tell your doctor. With some hormone conditions, these tests are not accurate.

faq.q: If I do not see ovulation, does that mean I cannot get pregnant?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Sometimes the surge is short and the test misses it. If this happens for several cycles, see a doctor.

reminders.text: Ovulation test in 2 hours. Do not drink a lot now, and try not to pee.
